techniques.evidence: src/lib/recaps/store.local.ts:13 Directly queries the unpooled global DatabaseSync handle without admission control or acquisition tracking.
src/lib/recaps/store.local.ts:19 JSON deserialization failure silently returns null without carrying a typed error, quarantining the handle, or routing writes to an alternative sink.

src/lib/recaps/store.local.ts:24 Recap store operations are not tracked in latency ring buffers, do not record rows touched or lock wait times, and emit no slow-operation warnings.
src/lib/recaps/store.local.ts:1 No activity gauge exists to gate WAL checkpoints or maintenance passes based on foreground load.
src/lib/recaps/store.ts:17 Module dynamic import caches the store layer without coordinated invalidation or holder checks against concurrent processes.
